items.title: 星闪开源，能否打通万物互联的“最后一米”？
items.raw_excerpt: 当整个行业都在争着打造大模型、Agent 这些 AI 时代的大脑时，华为把目光投向了整个体系的神经末梢。 在 HDC 2026 期间，华为决定将星闪协议栈将于 2026 年 7 月全量开源至 OpenHarmony 社区。这套此前只属于华为终端产品内部的短距通信能力，将第一次以开源形式向整个产业链敞开。 过去很长一段时间，Wi-Fi 和蓝牙完成了无线化的普及。它们让设备摆脱线缆，也让耳机、鼠标、手表、音箱和各类智能家居设备进入日常生活。 但随着 AIoT 进入更深层的发展阶段，设备连接从单点联网走向多设备协同，用户对连接的要求也发生了变化。过去只要配得上、连得上，现在还要连得稳、反应快，并且能够同时接入更多设备。 这些连接难题，正是星闪已经补上的短板，这也意味着星闪将会有很长的路要走。 “开源”星闪，从技术突破走向产业共用 华为星闪的过往的发展历程中，已经有不少合作伙伴参与其中，华为是其中之一。 据华为终端 BG 产业发展副总裁秦尧向雷峰网介绍，星闪采用分层设计，和手机通信、蓝牙技术的逻辑相通，分为底层接入层、中层服务层和上层应用层。其中，接入层与硬件深度绑定，由海思主导，泰凌微、卓胜微等芯片企业参与相关芯片研发；服务层和应用层由华为终端主导开发。 本次开源则主要针对服务层和应用层的软件协议，相关代码将上架 GitLab，并纳入 OpenHarmony 社区，成为开源鸿蒙系统的核心组件之一。 星闪技术的落地是点状的突破，“开源”则是实现产业规模化爆发的杠杆。 秦尧表示，此前短距通信协议往往是各家芯片厂商深锁的“黑盒”，开发者在适配不同硬件时，不得不耗费大量精力去处理底层的协议兼容性问题，这无疑增加了IoT产品的研发周期与隐性成本。 而现在星闪将复杂的通信逻辑封装成了标准化的OpenHarmony系统组件（API），这让开发者的研发重心能够从无休止的“底层Bug修补”中解放出

excerpt_i18n.en: While the entire industry is racing to build large models and agents—the brains of the AI era—Huawei has set its sights on the nerve endings of the entire system. During HDC 2026, Huawei decided to fully open-source the SparkLink protocol stack to the OpenHarmony community in July 2026. This short-range communication capability, previously exclusive to Huawei's terminal products, will be made available to the entire industry chain in open-source form for the first time. For a long time, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth have driven the wireless revolution, freeing devices from cables and bringing headphones, mice, watches, speakers, and various smart home devices into daily life. However, as AIoT enters a deeper stage of development, device connections have shifted from single-point networking to multi-device collaboration, and user demands for connectivity have evolved. In the past, simply pairing and connecting was sufficient; now, connections must be stable, responsive, and capable of supporting multiple devices simultaneously. These connectivity challenges are precisely the gaps that SparkLink has already addressed, signaling a long road ahead for the technology. "Open-sourcing" SparkLink marks a transition from technological breakthroughs to industry-wide adoption. In the past development of Huawei's SparkLink, many partners have already participated, with Huawei being one of them. According to Qin Yao, Vice President of Industry Development at Huawei's Terminal BG, as introduced to Leiphone, SparkLink adopts a layered design, similar to the logic of mobile communications and Bluetooth technology, consisting of a bottom-layer access layer, a middle service layer, and an upper application layer. Among these, the access layer is deeply tied to hardware, led by HiSilicon, with contributions from Telink and Maxscend.
excerpt_i18n.es: Mientras toda la industria compite por desarrollar grandes modelos y agentes, los "cerebros" de la era de la IA, Huawei ha dirigido su atención a las terminaciones nerviosas de todo el sistema. Durante el HDC 2026, Huawei decidió liberar completamente el protocolo StarFlash en la comunidad OpenHarmony en julio de 2026. Esta capacidad de comunicación de corta distancia, que antes solo pertenecía a los productos terminales de Huawei, se abrirá por primera vez a toda la cadena industrial en forma de código abierto. Durante mucho tiempo, Wi-Fi y Bluetooth han popularizado la conectividad inalámbrica. Han liberado a los dispositivos de los cables y han integrado auriculares, ratones, relojes, altavoces y diversos dispositivos inteligentes para el hogar en la vida cotidiana.

At the China Auto Chongqing Forum, invited by Leiphone, during a seminar themed "OEMs X Tech Companies: How to Define the Next-Generation Car," Liu Yuxiang, Director of Product Planning and Definition at Changan Automobile, used this statement to summarize the changes occurring in the definition of automobiles in the AI era. In the past few years, the automotive industry's discussion of intelligence has largely revolved around specific functions, with different systems upgrading independently, forming the main content of the previous stage of smart car competition. However, in the AI era, such single-point upgrades are no longer sufficient to explain the changes in next-generation cars. Liu Yuxiang believes that future cars will increasingly resemble a system centrally coordinated by a central brain, where chassis, powertrain, cockpit, intelligent driving, and cloud no longer operate independently but need to be reorganized by the vehicle's overall intelligence. At this seminar, guests from OEMs, intelligent cockpit providers, automotive electronics companies, global parts suppliers, consumer electronics manufacturers, and autonomous driving logistics companies also offered similar judgments from their respective industry positions. Although their starting points differed, a consensus emerged: after AI enters the automotive sector, the changes go beyond adding a large model to the cockpit or enabling voice assistants to answer more questions. Instead, cars will transform from mechanical-electronic products into mobile intelligent entities capable of perception, decision-making, coordination, and continuous evolution. The core of the next-generation car is not single-point intelligence but vehicle-wide intelligence. In the past, automotive intelligence was largely domain-driven. Intelligent driving had its own system.

In March 2026, the National Data Administration released a figure: China’s daily token call volume had reached 140 trillion. In April, the Stanford AI Index Report noted that inference costs had dropped 280-fold over the past two years. Fang Lei, founder and chairman of JiuZhang Cloud, offered an analogy: the First Industrial Revolution began with Watt’s steam engine, but what truly defined that era was Ford’s assembly line—it turned a genius’s one-time inspiration into a product accessible to everyone. items.title: 天工3.1 重磅发布：上线 Skywork Design 与 Dynamic Workflows，给 AI 一张画布和一支军团
items.raw_excerpt: AI 时代最大的幻觉，是把 Demo 等同于产品。   一句 prompt 生成一个漂亮页面，截图发朋友圈，点赞过百。但你真拿它去见客户，客户问：其他页面呢？配色统一吗？手机端适配了吗？能不能改一版？   Demo 和产品之间，差的就是这些问题。   Skywork 3.0 上线后一个月，天工超级智能体的收入实现了三倍增长 。 增长的背后，是越来越多的用户开始把天工当作交付结果的生产力工具来使用。   这一变化在用户行为数据里有具体的印证。在天工所有产出能力中， Websites 是用户沉淀最深的场景 。 用户并不满足于生成一个页面便离开，而是围绕同一个项目持续打磨：补充需求、调整结构、推翻重来、再次细化。 深度用户在单个 project 上的平均交互轮数超过 40 轮 ，许多复杂项目横跨多次登录才逐步成形。   而大多数人用AI，三轮就结束了。   我们发现这群深度用户使用天工的方式完全不同。他们不是来问答的，是来建造的——来构建一件长期的、复杂的、属于自己的东西。这些需求超长尾且高度个性化，一次生成做不出来，只能在反复迭代中逐渐定型。   第 1 轮到第 3 轮，出来的是 Demo。第 4 轮到第 40 轮，出来的才是产品。   今天 Skywork 隆重推出 3.1，正是对这群用户的回应。我们带来两项新能力：以画布承载设计的 Skywork Design，以及调度多 Agent 并行的 Dynamic Workflows。四月中旬 Claude 上线了 Design，五月底上线了 Dynamic Workflows ——天工3.1一次推出，国内与海外市场同步上线。   Skywork Design：对话框装不下的东西，铺在画布上   当你和 AI 聊到第 15 轮的时候

excerpt_i18n.en:
The biggest illusion of the AI era is equating a demo with a product. A single prompt generates a beautiful page, you screenshot it and post it on social media, and it gets hundreds of likes. But when you actually take it to a client, they ask: Where are the other pages? Is the color scheme consistent? Is it adapted for mobile? Can you make a revision? The gap between a demo and a product lies in these very questions.

One month after the launch of Skywork 3.0, the revenue of Tiangong Super Agent tripled. Behind this growth is an increasing number of users treating Tiangong as a productivity tool for delivering results.

This shift is concretely reflected in user behavior data. Among all of Tiangong's output capabilities, Websites is the scenario where users engage most deeply. Users are not satisfied with generating a single page and leaving; instead, they continuously refine the same project—adding requirements, adjusting structures, starting over, and further detailing. Deep users average over 40 interaction rounds per single project, with many complex projects taking shape across multiple login sessions.

Most people, however, end their AI usage after just three rounds.

We found that this group of deep users interacts with Tiangong in a fundamentally different way. They are not here for Q&A—they are here to build: to construct something long-term, complex, and personal. These needs are ultra-long-tail and highly individualized, impossible to achieve in a single generation—only through repeated iteration.
excerpt_i18n.es: La mayor ilusión de la era de la IA es equiparar una demo con un producto. Un prompt genera una página bonita, la capturas de pantalla y la publicas en redes sociales, y obtienes cien "me gusta". Pero cuando realmente la llevas a un cliente, este pregunta: ¿dónde están las demás páginas? ¿Los colores son uniformes? ¿Está adaptada para móviles? ¿Se puede modificar una versión? Entre una demo y un producto, la diferencia radica en estas preguntas. Un mes después del lanzamiento de Skywork 3.0, los ingresos de Tiangong Super Agent se triplicaron. Detrás de este crecimiento, cada vez más usuarios utilizan Tiangong como una herramienta de productividad para entregar resultados.
